1. Introduction & Definitions
1. 介绍与定义

Why study pn junctions?
为什么要研究 PN 结？

  • They are the common building blocks in semiconductor devices.
    它们是半导体器件中常见的基本构件。

    n substrate  n 型衬底
A conventional npn bipolar transistor structure
传统的 npn 双极型晶体管结构
Two MOS Field Effect Transistors connected as a CMOS inverter
两个 MOS 场效应晶体管连接成的 CMOS 反相器

1. Introduction & Definitions
1. 介绍与定义

Junction - the joining together of two dissimilar materials: e.g. metal-semiconductor (Schottky) junction, pn junctions
结 junction - 两种不同材料的结合处：例如金属-半导体（肖特基）结，pn 结

pn junction PN- a p-type semiconductor region is formed in electronic contact with an n-type semiconductor on the same single crystal semiconductor material.
pn 结 PN - 在同一单晶半导体材料上形成的 p 型半导体区域与 n 型半导体电子接触。
Metallurgical junction - the interface between the p- and n-doped regions.
冶金结 - p 型和 n 型掺杂区域之间的界面。

1. Introduction & Definitions
1. 介绍与定义

Substrate - silicon wafer on which the pn junction is made.
衬底 - 制作 PN 结的硅片。
Ohmic contact - a metal-Si junction which allows electrical current to pass freely through the silicon. The contact itself should have a linear I-V characteristic.
欧姆接触 - 一种金属-硅结，允许电流自由通过硅。该接触本身应具有线性电流-电压特性。
Silicon dioxide insulator acts to passivate the silicon surface electrical properties and to provide electrical isolation from neighbouring devices.
二氧化硅绝缘层用于钝化硅表面的电学特性，并提供与邻近器件的电气隔离。

2. PN Junction at Thermal Equilibrium
2. 热平衡下的 PN 结

Thermal Equilibrium implies that
热平衡意味着
  • the material has reached steady state (i.e. independent of time),
    材料已达到稳态（即时间无关），
  • assumed its lowest energy state, in an environment in which there are
    假设其处于最低能量状态，且环境中存在
  • no external energy sources such as voltages, light, electric fields, magnetic fields or temperature gradients acting on it
    无外部能量源，如电压、光、电场、磁场或温度梯度作用于其上
Consider only abrupt junctions with uniform doping in each region.
仅考虑每个区域掺杂均匀的突变结。

2. PN Junction at Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结在热平衡状态下

2.1 Fermi Level at Thermal Equilibrium
2.1 热平衡下的费米能级

-What happens when a pn junction is formed & reaches thermal equilibrium? Consider the following thought experiment …
- 当 PN 结形成并达到热平衡时会发生什么？请考虑以下思考实验……
  • Consider first two separate semiconductor wafers: an n-type semiconductor and a p-type. Consider what happens if we bring these two together to form a junction.
    首先考虑两个独立的半导体晶片：一个是 N 型半导体，另一个是 P 型半导体。考虑如果将这两者结合形成一个结会发生什么。
    E v a c E v a c E_(vac)E_{v a c}--------------------- E v a c E v a c E_(vac)E_{v a c}
  • From the Fermi levels, states are occupied to a higher energy level in the n-region than in the p-region.
    从费米能级来看，N 区的态被占据到比 P 区更高的能级。
  • Both electrons & holes can lower their energies by crossing the junction.
    电子和空穴都可以通过穿越结降低它们的能量。

When the p-region first contacts the n-region …

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态下

From the perspective of energy potential diagram
从能量势垒图的角度来看

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态下

When the p - and n -sides first contact, the large concentration of electrons on the n -side and low-concentration on the p-side results in a large diffusion flux from the n - to the p -side. (Similarly for holes.)
当 p 侧和 n 侧首次接触时，n 侧大量的电子浓度和 p 侧较低的浓度导致从 n 侧到 p 侧的大量扩散通量。（空穴亦然。）

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态

A potential barrier starts to form in the growing space-charge region:
在不断扩大的空间电荷区中开始形成势垒：

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态

The potential barrier continues to increase as the carrier flux continues (but at a reduced rate, since only carriers with sufficient energy to overcome the barrier can diffuse through the other side):
随着载流子通量的持续，势垒继续增加（但速率减缓，因为只有具有足够能量克服势垒的载流子才能扩散到另一侧）：

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态

Finally, at thermal equilibrium, there is not net flux of carriers from one side to the other as the potential barrier maintains equilibrium between majority and minority carriers on either side of the junction:
最终，在热平衡状态下，由于势垒维持了结两侧多数载流子和少数载流子之间的平衡，载流子从一侧到另一侧的净通量为零：

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

While often neglected in a homojunction (a junction involving the same material - e.g. Si ), the vacuum level is an important energy level. To complete the picture, the vacuum level is parallel to E C E C E_(C)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}} and above it by an energy given by the electron affinity χ χ chi\chi.
虽然在同质结（涉及相同材料的结，例如硅）中常被忽略，真空能级是一个重要的能级。为了完整描述，真空能级与 E C E C E_(C)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}} 平行，并且高出它一个由电子亲和能 χ χ chi\chi 给出的能量。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

Junction Potential Barrier
结势垒

-We saw that the formation of a pn junction at thermal equilibrium results in a potential barrier.
我们看到，在热平衡状态下形成的 pn 结会产生一个势垒。
  • Electrons in the CB on the n -side will see an energy barrier of eV bi eV bi eV_(bi)\mathrm{eV}_{\mathrm{bi}} in crossing over to the p -side.
    n 侧导带中的电子在跨越到 p 侧时将遇到一个能量势垒，大小为 eV bi eV bi eV_(bi)\mathrm{eV}_{\mathrm{bi}} 。
  • Holes in the VB on the p-side will likewise see an energy barrier of eV bi eV bi eV_(bi)\mathrm{eV}_{\mathrm{bi}} in crossing over to the nside.
    p 侧价带中的空穴在跨越到 n 侧时同样会遇到一个能量势垒，大小为 eV bi eV bi eV_(bi)\mathrm{eV}_{\mathrm{bi}} 。

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态下的分析

  • The potential barrier (in V ) at thermal equilibrium is referred to as the builtin potential barrier and is denoted by V bi V bi  V_("bi ")V_{\text {bi }}.
    热平衡时的势垒电压（单位：伏特）称为内建势垒电压，记作 V bi V bi  V_("bi ")V_{\text {bi }} 。
  • Defining potentials ϕ F n ϕ F n phi_(Fn)\phi_{F n} and ϕ F p ϕ F p phi_(Fp)\phi_{F p} in the p p pp - and n n nn - neutral regions as e φ F n = E F i − E F e φ F n = E F i − E F evarphi_(Fn)=E_(Fi)-E_(F)quade \varphi_{F n}=E_{F i}-E_{F} \quad (n-region) e φ F p = E F i − E F e φ F p = E F i − E F quad evarphi_(Fp)=E_(Fi)-E_(F)quad\quad e \varphi_{F p}=E_{F i}-E_{F} \quad (p-region)
    在 p p pp 区和 n n nn 区的中性区定义电势 ϕ F n ϕ F n phi_(Fn)\phi_{F n} 和 ϕ F p ϕ F p phi_(Fp)\phi_{F p} ，分别为 e φ F n = E F i − E F e φ F n = E F i − E F evarphi_(Fn)=E_(Fi)-E_(F)quade \varphi_{F n}=E_{F i}-E_{F} \quad （n 区）和 e φ F p = E F i − E F e φ F p = E F i − E F quad evarphi_(Fp)=E_(Fi)-E_(F)quad\quad e \varphi_{F p}=E_{F i}-E_{F} \quad （p 区）。

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态

  • It is clear that the potential barrier is given by V b i = | ϕ F p | + | ϕ F n | V b i = ϕ F p + ϕ F n quadV_(bi)=|phi_(F_(p))|+|phi_(F_(n))|\quad V_{b i}=\left|\phi_{F_{p}}\right|+\left|\phi_{F_{n}}\right|
    很明显，势垒电压由 V b i = | ϕ F p | + | ϕ F n | V b i = ϕ F p + ϕ F n quadV_(bi)=|phi_(F_(p))|+|phi_(F_(n))|\quad V_{b i}=\left|\phi_{F_{p}}\right|+\left|\phi_{F_{n}}\right| 给出。
Now, since  现在，因为
n 0 = n i exp ⁡ [ E F − E F i k T ] = n i exp ⁡ [ − ( e ϕ F n ) k T ] ⇒ ϕ F n = − k T e ln ⁡ ( N d n i ) n 0 = n i exp ⁡ E F − E F i k T = n i exp ⁡ − e ϕ F n k T ⇒ ϕ F n = − k T e ln ⁡ N d n i {:[n_(0)=n_(i)exp[(E_(F)-E_(Fi))/(kT)]=n_(i)exp[(-(ephi_(Fn)))/(kT)]],[=>phi_(Fn)=(-kT)/(e)ln((N_(d))/(n_(i)))]:}\begin{aligned} & n_{0}=n_{i} \exp \left[\frac{E_{F}-E_{F i}}{k T}\right]=n_{i} \exp \left[\frac{-\left(e \phi_{F n}\right)}{k T}\right] \\ & \Rightarrow \phi_{F n}=\frac{-k T}{e} \ln \left(\frac{N_{d}}{n_{i}}\right) \end{aligned}
Similarly  类似地
p 0 = n i exp ⁡ [ E F i − E F k T ] = n i exp ⁡ [ + ( e ϕ F p ) k T ] ⇒ ϕ F p = k T e ln ⁡ ( N a n i ) p 0 = n i exp ⁡ E F i − E F k T = n i exp ⁡ + e ϕ F p k T ⇒ ϕ F p = k T e ln ⁡ N a n i {:[p_(0)=n_(i)exp[(E_(Fi)-E_(F))/(kT)]=n_(i)exp[(+(ephi_(Fp)))/(kT)]],[=>phi_(Fp)=(kT)/(e)ln((N_(a))/(n_(i)))]:}\begin{aligned} & p_{0}=n_{i} \exp \left[\frac{E_{F i}-E_{F}}{k T}\right]=n_{i} \exp \left[\frac{+\left(e \phi_{F p}\right)}{k T}\right] \\ & \Rightarrow \phi_{F p}=\frac{k T}{e} \ln \left(\frac{N_{a}}{n_{i}}\right) \end{aligned}

2. PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
2. PN 结 - 热平衡状态

V b i = | φ F p | + | φ F n | = k T e ln ⁡ ( N a n i ) + k T e ln ⁡ ( N d n i ) = k T e ln ⁡ ( N a N d n i 2 ) = V t ln ⁡ ( N a N d n i 2 ) V b i = φ F p + φ F n = k T e ln ⁡ N a n i + k T e ln ⁡ N d n i = k T e ln ⁡ N a N d n i 2 = V t ln ⁡ N a N d n i 2 V_(bi)=|varphi_(F_(p))|+|varphi_(F_(n))|=(kT)/(e)ln((N_(a))/(n_(i)))+(kT)/(e)ln((N_(d))/(n_(i)))=(kT)/(e)ln((N_(a)N_(d))/(n_(i)^(2)))=V_(t)ln((N_(a)N_(d))/(n_(i)^(2)))V_{b i}=\left|\varphi_{F_{p}}\right|+\left|\varphi_{F_{n}}\right|=\frac{k T}{e} \ln \left(\frac{N_{a}}{n_{i}}\right)+\frac{k T}{e} \ln \left(\frac{N_{d}}{n_{i}}\right)=\frac{k T}{e} \ln \left(\frac{N_{a} N_{d}}{n_{i}^{2}}\right)=V_{t} \ln \left(\frac{N_{a} N_{d}}{n_{i}^{2}}\right)
where V t = k T e V t = k T e V_(t)=(kT)/(e)V_{t}=\frac{k T}{e} is the thermal voltage ( = 0.0259 V = 0.0259 V =0.0259V=0.0259 \mathrm{~V} at T = 300 K T = 300 K T=300KT=300 \mathrm{~K} )
其中 V t = k T e V t = k T e V_(t)=(kT)/(e)V_{t}=\frac{k T}{e} 是热电压（ = 0.0259 V = 0.0259 V =0.0259V=0.0259 \mathrm{~V} 在 T = 300 K T = 300 K T=300KT=300 \mathrm{~K} ）

2.S Equation Summary  2.S 方程总结

  1. Built-in potential of pn junction:
    PN 结的内建电势：
V b i = k T e ln ⁡ ( N a N d n i 2 ) = V t ln ⁡ ( N a N d n i 2 ) V b i = k T e ln ⁡ N a N d n i 2 = V t ln ⁡ N a N d n i 2 V_(bi)=(kT)/(e)ln((N_(a)N_(d))/(n_(i)^(2)))=V_(t)ln((N_(a)N_(d))/(n_(i)^(2)))V_{b i}=\frac{k T}{e} \ln \left(\frac{N_{a} N_{d}}{n_{i}^{2}}\right)=V_{t} \ln \left(\frac{N_{a} N_{d}}{n_{i}^{2}}\right)
where:  其中：
V t = k T e ≈ 0.0259 eV at T = 300 K V t = k T e ≈ 0.0259 eV  at  T = 300 K V_(t)=(kT)/(e)~~0.0259eV" at "T=300KV_{t}=\frac{k T}{e} \approx 0.0259 \mathrm{eV} \text { at } T=300 \mathrm{~K}
is the “thermal voltage”.
是“热电压”。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

  • When the p-region first contacts the n-region …
    当 p 区首次接触到 n 区时……
  • p-region has many more holes than the nregion.
    p 区的空穴远多于 n 区。
  • Hence the holes diffuse from the p-region to the n-region
    因此空穴从 p 区扩散到 n 区
  • n-region has many more electrons than the p-region.
    n 区的电子比 p 区多得多。
  • Hence the electrons diffuse from the nregion to the p-region
    因此电子从 n 区扩散到 p 区

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

Hole diffusion  空穴扩散 n
p Electron diffusion  电子扩散
Hole diffusion n https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/2025_05_23_a65e1357ccc8b17b290eg-33.jpg?height=286&width=1123&top_left_y=478&top_left_x=146 p Electron diffusion| Hole diffusion | n | | :--- | :--- | | | ![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/2025_05_23_a65e1357ccc8b17b290eg-33.jpg?height=286&width=1123&top_left_y=478&top_left_x=146) | | | p Electron diffusion |

  • As holes diffuse from the p-region, they leave behind -ve space charge from the fixed ionized acceptors.
    当空穴从 p 区扩散时，它们留下了来自固定电离受主的负空间电荷。
  • When the holes arrive at the neutral n-region, they recombine with the (plentiful) electrons there.
    当空穴到达中性 n 区时，它们与那里的（大量）电子复合。
  • Likewise, as electrons diffuse from the nregion, they leave behind +ve space charge from the fixed ionized donors.
    同样地，当电子从 n 区扩散时，它们留下了来自固定电离施主的正空间电荷。
  • When the electrons arrive at the neutral pregion, they recombine with the (plentiful) holes there.
    当电子到达中性 P 区时，它们与那里的（大量）空穴复合。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态下

Electric field  电场


  • The resulting space charge ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(x) gives rise to an electric field E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)\mathrm{E}(\mathrm{x}).
    由此产生的空间电荷 ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(x) 引起了电场 E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)\mathrm{E}(\mathrm{x}) 。
  • We will show later that E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)\mathrm{E}(\mathrm{x}) is related to the charge density ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(\mathrm{x})
    我们稍后将展示 E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)\mathrm{E}(\mathrm{x}) 与电荷密度 ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(\mathrm{x}) 的关系
d E ( x ) d x = ρ ( x ) ε s ⇒ E ( x ) = ∫ ρ ( x ) / ε s d x d E ( x ) d x = ρ ( x ) ε s ⇒ E ( x ) = ∫ ρ ( x ) / ε s d x {:[(dE(x))/(dx)=(rho(x))/(epsi_(s))],[=>E(x)=int rho(x)//epsi_(s)dx]:}\begin{aligned} & \frac{d \mathrm{E}(x)}{d x}=\frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{E}(x)=\int \rho(x) / \varepsilon_{s} d x \end{aligned}
where ε s = ε 0 ε r ε s = ε 0 ε r epsi_(s)=epsi_(0)epsi_(r)\varepsilon_{s}=\varepsilon_{0} \varepsilon_{r} is the permittivity of the semiconductor.
其中 ε s = ε 0 ε r ε s = ε 0 ε r epsi_(s)=epsi_(0)epsi_(r)\varepsilon_{s}=\varepsilon_{0} \varepsilon_{r} 是半导体的介电常数。
  • The resulting electric field acts as a force to “drag” the diffusing carriers back in the opposite direction.
    由此产生的电场作为一种力，将扩散的载流子“拖回”相反方向。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态下

Microscopic picture  微观图像

Consider the holes - the diffusing holes have different kinetic energies, depending on their position in the energy band diagram.
考虑空穴——扩散的空穴具有不同的动能，取决于它们在能带图中的位置。
Due to the space charge, the hole will experience an electrostatic force from right to left in the SCR.
由于空间电荷，空穴将在耗尽区内受到从右向左的静电力作用。
Holes with sufficient velocity (from left to right**) will be able to diffuse all the way through the SCR to the neutral n region. Those with less will be accelerated by the E-field back towards the neutral p-region.
具有足够速度（从左向右**）的空穴能够扩散穿过耗尽区到达中性 n 区。速度较低的空穴将被电场加速，返回中性 p 区。
** Diffusion is a statistical process - in a field-free region, there are as many holes travelling from left to right as there are from right to left.
** 扩散是一个统计过程——在无电场区域，向左向右移动的空穴数量相等。

  • At this point, there is still a net diffusion of carriers, but at a reduced rate as fewer make it across the SCR.
    此时，载流子的净扩散仍然存在，但由于穿过空间电荷区的载流子减少，扩散速率降低。
  • As a result, the space-charge region continues to widen, and the electric field continues to increase.
    因此，空间电荷区继续扩大，电场持续增强。
  • The increase in electric field increases the electric-field force, and reduces the net flux …
    电场的增强增加了电场力，并减少了净通量……

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态下


  • At steady state & thermal equilibrium, the diffusion “force” is balanced by the electric-field force, such that there is no further net flux of carriers.
    在稳态和热平衡下，扩散“力”与电场力平衡，因此载流子没有进一步的净通量。
  • Note that the space-charge layer comprises mainly:
    注意，空间电荷层主要包括：
  • Fixed ionized acceptors  固定的电离受主
    ( ρ ( x ) = − e N a ) ρ ( x ) = − e N a (rho(x)=-eN_(a))\left(\rho(x)=-e N_{a}\right) on the p-side   ( ρ ( x ) = − e N a ) ρ ( x ) = − e N a (rho(x)=-eN_(a))\left(\rho(x)=-e N_{a}\right) 在 p 侧
  • Fixed ionized donors ( ρ ( x ) = + e N d ) ρ ( x ) = + e N d (rho(x)=+eN_(d))\left(\rho(x)=+e N_{d}\right) on the n-side.
    固定的电离施主 ( ρ ( x ) = + e N d ) ρ ( x ) = + e N d (rho(x)=+eN_(d))\left(\rho(x)=+e N_{d}\right) 在 n 侧。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

  • The main changes (in n o , p o n o , p o n_(o),p_(o)\mathrm{n}_{\mathrm{o}}, \mathrm{p}_{\mathrm{o}} ) occur in the space-charge region around the metallurgical junction.
    主要变化（在 n o , p o n o , p o n_(o),p_(o)\mathrm{n}_{\mathrm{o}}, \mathrm{p}_{\mathrm{o}} 中）发生在冶金结周围的空间电荷区。
    -The other regions are not changed.
    - 其他区域没有变化。

p-type |----| -----| -----| +++++++ +++++++ +++++++ +++++++ ntype| p-type | ```\|----| -----| -----|``` | +++++++ +++++++ +++++++ +++++++ | ntype | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

log ⁡ p o log ⁡ p o log p_(o)\log p_{o} and log ⁡ n o log ⁡ n o log n_(o)\log n_{o} plotted across the junction at thermal equilibrium
log ⁡ p o log ⁡ p o log p_(o)\log p_{o} 和 log ⁡ n o log ⁡ n o log n_(o)\log n_{o} 在热平衡状态下跨越结区的分布图。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

  • At thermal equilibrium, a pn junction can be divided into three regions:
    在热平衡状态下，PN 结可以分为三个区域：
    (1) p-type neutral region
    (1) P 型中性区
    (2) space-charge region (or depletion region)
    （2）空间电荷区（或耗尽区）
    (3) n-type neutral region.
    (3) N 型中性区
  • Far away from the metallurgical junction, nothing much has changed in the two neutral regions:
    远离冶金结处，两侧的中性区几乎没有变化：
    p-region: p p 0 ≈ N a p p 0 ≈ N a p_(p0)~~N_(a)p_{p 0} \approx N_{a}  p 区: p p 0 ≈ N a p p 0 ≈ N a p_(p0)~~N_(a)p_{p 0} \approx N_{a}
    n-region: n n 0 ≈ N d n n 0 ≈ N d n_(n0)~~N_(d)n_{n 0} \approx N_{d}  n 区: n n 0 ≈ N d n n 0 ≈ N d n_(n0)~~N_(d)n_{n 0} \approx N_{d}

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

  • But in the space-charge region, the carrier concentrations are very low compared with the concentrations of the respective fixed charges (acceptors, donors):
    但在空间电荷区，载流子浓度与各自的固定电荷（受主、施主）浓度相比非常低：

Carrier concentrations in pn junction with N a = 10 16 cm − 3 N a = 10 16 cm − 3 N_(a)=10^(16)cm^(-3)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{a}}=10^{16} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} and N d = 10 17 cm − 3 N d = 10 17 cm − 3 N_(d)=10^(17)cm^(-3)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{d}}=10^{17} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}
具有 N a = 10 16 cm − 3 N a = 10 16 cm − 3 N_(a)=10^(16)cm^(-3)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{a}}=10^{16} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} 和 N d = 10 17 cm − 3 N d = 10 17 cm − 3 N_(d)=10^(17)cm^(-3)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{d}}=10^{17} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} 的 PN 结中的载流子浓度
  • log plot (left) and linear plot (right)
    对数图（左）和线性图（右）

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

Depletion Approximation  耗尽近似法

  • It is seen that the carrier concentrations in the space-charge region can be considerably lower than the respective dopant concentrations, i.e., on the p-side, p 0 ≪ N a p 0 ≪ N a p_(0)≪N_(a)\mathrm{p}_{0} \ll \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{a}}, while on the n-side, n 0 ≪ N d n 0 ≪ N d n_(0)≪N_(d)\mathrm{n}_{0} \ll \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{d}}.
    可以看出，空间电荷区内的载流子浓度可以远低于相应的掺杂浓度，即在 p 侧为 p 0 ≪ N a p 0 ≪ N a p_(0)≪N_(a)\mathrm{p}_{0} \ll \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{a}} ，而在 n 侧为 n 0 ≪ N d n 0 ≪ N d n_(0)≪N_(d)\mathrm{n}_{0} \ll \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{d}} 。
  • With the depletion approximation, we assume:
    在耗尽近似下，我们假设：
  1. Insignificant electron & hole concentrations in the SCR,
    空间电荷区内电子和空穴浓度可以忽略不计，
  2. Neutral regions are perfectly charge neutral, and
    中性区完全电中性，且
  3. Transition between the depletion region (SCR) and neutral region is abrupt, and defined by x p x p x_(p)x_{p} and x n x n x_(n)x_{n}.
    空间电荷区（SCR）与中性区之间的过渡是突变的，由 x p x p x_(p)x_{p} 和 x n x n x_(n)x_{n} 定义。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态下

  • Hence based on the depletion approximation, the space-charge region is also called the depletion region. Several observations:
    因此，基于耗尽近似，空间电荷区也称为耗尽区。几个观察点：
  1. The “depletion region” is not really depleted of carriers, just that the carrier concentrations here are much lower than the respective fixed ionized dopant concentration.
    “耗尽区”实际上并非完全没有载流子，只是该区域的载流子浓度远低于相应的固定电离掺杂浓度。
  2. In the “depletion region”, the electron concentration is even higher than the electron (minority carrier) concentration on the p-side. Likewise for the hole concentration on the n n nn side.
    在“耗尽区”，电子浓度甚至高于 p 侧的电子（少数载流子）浓度。对于 n n nn 侧的空穴浓度也是如此。
    See log-plot ⇒ ⇒ =>\Rightarrow  见对数图 ⇒ ⇒ =>\Rightarrow

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

  1. The space-charge density in the “depletion region” is then given by the dopant charge concentration.
    “耗尽区”内的空间电荷密度由掺杂剂电荷浓度决定。
  2. Outside the depletion region (in the “neutral regions”), the space charge is zero.
    在耗尽区外（“中性区”内），空间电荷为零。

PN Junction - At Thermal Equilibrium
PN 结 - 热平衡状态

  1. Overall, the device is electrically neutral, i.e., the net charge in the device is zero.
    总体上，器件是电中性的，即器件中的净电荷为零。
This means that the total negative space charge must be equal to the positive space charge, viz.
这意味着总的负空间电荷必须等于正空间电荷，即
∫ − x p + x n ρ ( x ) ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p 0 − e N a ⋅ d x + ∫ 0 x n + e N d ⋅ d x = 0 ⇒ e N a x p = e N d x n ∫ − x p + x n   ρ ( x ) ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p 0   − e N a ⋅ d x + ∫ 0 x n   + e N d ⋅ d x = 0 ⇒ e N a x p = e N d x n {:[int_(-x_(p))^(+x_(n))rho(x)*dx=int_(-x_(p))^(0)-eN_(a)*dx+int_(0)^(x_(n))+eN_(d)*dx=0],[=>eN_(a)x_(p)=eN_(d)x_(n)]:}\begin{aligned} \int_{-x_{p}}^{+x_{n}} \rho(x) \cdot d x= & \int_{-x_{p}}^{0}-e N_{a} \cdot d x+\int_{0}^{x_{n}}+e N_{d} \cdot d x=0 \\ & \Rightarrow e N_{a} x_{p}=e N_{d} x_{n} \end{aligned}
or, equivalently, the areas under the space-charge curve must be equal & opposite.
或者等效地，空间电荷曲线下的面积必须相等且相反。

PN Junction - Electrostatic Analysis
PN 结 - 静电分析

1. Why do we need the electrostatic analysis
1. 为什么我们需要电静力学分析

Q: How is the space charge near the metallurgical junction related to the electric field and potential?
问：金属学结附近的空间电荷如何与电场和电势相关？
The relationship between the space charge, electric field, and potential is governed by Gauss’s Law. In its one-dimensional form, Gauss’s Law states:
空间电荷、电场和电势之间的关系由高斯定律控制。在一维形式中，高斯定律表述为：
d E d x = ρ ( x ) ε 0 ε r = ρ ( x ) ε d E d x = ρ ( x ) ε 0 ε r = ρ ( x ) ε (dE)/(dx)=(rho(x))/(epsi_(0)epsi_(r))=(rho(x))/(epsi)\frac{d \mathrm{E}}{d x}=\frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{0} \varepsilon_{r}}=\frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon}
where E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)E(x) is the electric field at x , ε x , ε x,epsix, \varepsilon is the total permittivity of the material, ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(x) is the charge density per unit volume (C/cm³) at x x xx comprising all possible charges in the semiconductor (ionized dopants, electrons, holes).
其中 E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)E(x) 是 x , ε x , ε x,epsix, \varepsilon 处的电场， ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(x) 是材料的总介电常数， x x xx 处的电荷密度（单位体积电荷，C/cm³），包括半导体中所有可能的电荷（电离掺杂剂、电子、空穴）。

PN Junction - Electrostatic Analysis
PN 结 - 静电分析

This equation can be integrated to give us the electric field
该方程可以积分得到电场
E ( x 1 ) − E ( x 2 ) = ∫ x 1 x 2 ρ ( x ) ε ⋅ d x E x 1 − E x 2 = ∫ x 1 x 2   ρ ( x ) ε ⋅ d x E(x_(1))-E(x_(2))=int_(x_(1))^(x_(2))(rho(x))/(epsi)*dx\mathrm{E}\left(x_{1}\right)-\mathrm{E}\left(x_{2}\right)=\int_{x_{1}}^{x_{2}} \frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon} \cdot d x
Since the electric field is related to the potential ϕ ϕ phi\phi by,
由于电场与电势 ϕ ϕ phi\phi 相关，
E ( x ) = − d ϕ d x E ( x ) = − d ϕ d x E(x)=-(d phi)/(dx)E(x)=-\frac{d \phi}{d x}
the potential ϕ ( x ) ϕ ( x ) phi(x)\phi(x) is therefore given by:
因此电势 ϕ ( x ) ϕ ( x ) phi(x)\phi(x) 可表示为：
ϕ ( x 1 ) − ϕ ( x 2 ) = ∫ x 1 x 2 − E ( x ) ⋅ d x ϕ x 1 − ϕ x 2 = ∫ x 1 x 2   − E ( x ) ⋅ d x phi(x_(1))-phi(x_(2))=int_(x_(1))^(x_(2))-E(x)*dx\phi\left(x_{1}\right)-\phi\left(x_{2}\right)=\int_{x_{1}}^{x_{2}}-\mathrm{E}(x) \cdot d x
We are often interested only in potential differences, so an arbitrary reference is then required.
我们通常只关心电势差，因此需要一个任意的参考点。
Finally, the vacuum level is related to the potential via:
最后，真空能级与电势的关系为：
E v a c ( x ) = − e ⋅ ϕ ( x ) E v a c ( x ) = − e ⋅ ϕ ( x ) E_(vac)(x)=-e*phi(x)E_{v a c}(x)=-e \cdot \phi(x)

PN 结 - 静电分析

2. Calculation of Electric Field and Potential
2. 电场和电势的计算

Let us return to the pn junction at thermal equilibrium. Making use of the depletion approximation, we need only consider space charge in the depletion layer, as it is neutral everywhere else.
让我们回到热平衡状态下的 pn 结。利用耗尽近似，我们只需考虑耗尽层中的空间电荷，因为其他地方是电中性的。
Assuming complete ionization of dopants, we have:
假设掺杂剂完全电离，我们有：
− x p < x < 0 : ρ ( x ) = − e N a − x p < x < 0 : ρ ( x ) = − e N a -x_(p) < x < 0quad:quad rho(x)=-eN_(a)-x_{p}<x<0 \quad: \quad \rho(x)=-e N_{a}
0 < x < x n : ρ ( x ) = + e N d 0 < x < x n : ρ ( x ) = + e N d 0 < x < x_(n)quad:quad rho(x)=+eN_(d)0<x<x_{n} \quad: \quad \rho(x)=+e N_{d}
Elsewhere : ρ ( x ) = 0 ρ ( x ) = 0 rho(x)=0\rho(x)=0  其他地方： ρ ( x ) = 0 ρ ( x ) = 0 rho(x)=0\rho(x)=0

PN Junction - Electrostatic Analysis
PN 结 - 静电分析

If we integrate the charge density ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(\mathrm{x}), we get E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)E(\mathrm{x})
如果我们对电荷密度 ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(\mathrm{x}) 积分，得到 E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)E(\mathrm{x})
For − x p < x < 0 − x p < x < 0 -x_(p) < x < 0-x_{p}<x<0  对于 − x p < x < 0 − x p < x < 0 -x_(p) < x < 0-x_{p}<x<0
E ( x ) = ∫ − x p x ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p x − e N a ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a ε s ( x + x p ) E ( x ) = ∫ − x p x   ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p x   − e N a ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a ε s x + x p {:[E(x)=int_(-x_(p))^(x)(rho(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=int_(-x_(p))^(x)(-eN_(a)(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=(-eN_(a))/(epsi_(s))(x+x_(p))]:}\begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}(x) & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{x} \frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{x} \frac{-e N_{a}(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\frac{-e N_{a}}{\varepsilon_{s}}\left(x+x_{p}\right) \end{aligned}
For 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x_(n)0<x<x_{n}  对于 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x_(n)0<x<x_{n}
E ( x ) = ∫ − x p 0 ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x + ∫ 0 x ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a x p ε s + ∫ 0 x + e N d ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = E max + e N d x ε s E ( x ) = ∫ − x p 0   ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x + ∫ 0 x   ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a x p ε s + ∫ 0 x   + e N d ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = E max + e N d x ε s {:[E(x)=int_(-x_(p))^(0)(rho(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx+int_(0)^(x)(rho(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=(-eN_(a)x_(p))/(epsi_(s))+int_(0)^(x)(+eN_(d)(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=E_(max)+(eN_(d)x)/(epsi_(s))]:}\begin{aligned} E(x) & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{0} \frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x+\int_{0}^{x} \frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\frac{-e N_{a} x_{p}}{\varepsilon_{s}}+\int_{0}^{x} \frac{+e N_{d}(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\mathrm{E}_{\max }+\frac{e N_{d} x}{\varepsilon_{s}} \end{aligned}
Note that the electric field increases from the edge of the depletion region and peaks at E ( 0 ) = E max E ( 0 ) = E max  E(0)=E_("max ")E(0)=E_{\text {max }} at the metallurgical junction.
注意电场从耗尽区边缘开始增加，并在冶金结处达到峰值 E ( 0 ) = E max E ( 0 ) = E max  E(0)=E_("max ")E(0)=E_{\text {max }} 。
Since the entire device is charge neutral, the electric field is zero outside the depletion region.
由于整个器件电荷中性，耗尽区外的电场为零。

PN Junction - Electrostatic Analysis
PN 结 - 静电分析

If we integrate the charge density ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(\mathrm{x}), we get E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)E(\mathrm{x})
如果我们对电荷密度 ρ ( x ) ρ ( x ) rho(x)\rho(\mathrm{x}) 积分，我们得到 E ( x ) E ( x ) E(x)E(\mathrm{x}) 。
For − x p < x < 0 − x p < x < 0 -x_(p) < x < 0-x_{p}<x<0  对于 − x p < x < 0 − x p < x < 0 -x_(p) < x < 0-x_{p}<x<0 。
E ( x ) = ∫ − x p x ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p x − e N a ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a ε s ( x + x p ) E ( x ) = ∫ − x p x   ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p x   − e N a ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a ε s x + x p {:[E(x)=int_(-x_(p))^(x)(rho(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=int_(-x_(p))^(x)(-eN_(a)(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=(-eN_(a))/(epsi_(s))(x+x_(p))]:}\begin{aligned} E(x) & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{x} \frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{x} \frac{-e N_{a}(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\frac{-e N_{a}}{\varepsilon_{s}}\left(x+x_{p}\right) \end{aligned}
For 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x_(n)0<x<x_{n}  对于 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x_(n)0<x<x_{n}
E ( x ) = ∫ − x p 0 ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x + ∫ 0 x ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a x p ε s + ∫ 0 x + e N d ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = E max + e N d x ε s E max = − e N a x p ε s = − e N d x n ε s E ( x ) = ∫ − x p 0   ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x + ∫ 0 x   ρ ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = − e N a x p ε s + ∫ 0 x   + e N d ( x ) ε s ⋅ d x = E max + e N d x ε s E max = − e N a x p ε s = − e N d x n ε s {:[E(x)=int_(-x_(p))^(0)(rho(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx+int_(0)^(x)(rho(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=(-eN_(a)x_(p))/(epsi_(s))+int_(0)^(x)(+eN_(d)(x))/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=E_(max)+(eN_(d)x)/(epsi_(s))],[E_(max)=(-eN_(a)x_(p))/(epsi_(s))=(-eN_(d)x_(n))/(epsi_(s))]:}\begin{aligned} E(x) & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{0} \frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x+\int_{0}^{x} \frac{\rho(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\frac{-e N_{a} x_{p}}{\varepsilon_{s}}+\int_{0}^{x} \frac{+e N_{d}(x)}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\mathrm{E}_{\max }+\frac{e N_{d} x}{\varepsilon_{s}} \\ \mathrm{E}_{\max } & =\frac{-e N_{a} x_{p}}{\varepsilon_{s}}=\frac{-e N_{d} x_{n}}{\varepsilon_{s}} \end{aligned}
Note that Emax can also be obtained easily from the area under the charge density curve on either the p-region or the n-region.
注意，Emax 也可以很容易地从电荷密度曲线在 p 区或 n 区下的面积获得。

If we integrate the electric field, we get the potential:
如果我们对电场积分，就得到电势：
For − x p < x < 0 − x p < x < 0 -x_(p) < x < 0-x_{p}<x<0  对于 − x p < x < 0 − x p < x < 0 -x_(p) < x < 0-x_{p}<x<0
ϕ ( x ) = ∫ − x p x − E ( x ) ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p x e N a ε s ( x + x p ) ⋅ d x = e N a 2 ε s ( x + x p ) 2 ϕ ( x ) = ∫ − x p x   − E ( x ) ⋅ d x = ∫ − x p x   e N a ε s x + x p ⋅ d x = e N a 2 ε s x + x p 2 {:[phi(x)=int_(-x_(p))^(x)-E(x)*dx],[=int_(-x_(p))^(x)(eN_(a))/(epsi_(s))(x+x_(p))*dx],[=(eN_(a))/(2epsi_(s))(x+x_(p))^(2)]:}\begin{aligned} \phi(x) & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{x}-\mathrm{E}(x) \cdot d x \\ & =\int_{-x_{p}}^{x} \frac{e N_{a}}{\varepsilon_{s}}\left(x+x_{p}\right) \cdot d x \\ & =\frac{e N_{a}}{2 \varepsilon_{s}}\left(x+x_{p}\right)^{2} \end{aligned}
For 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x_(n)0<x<x_{n}  对于 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x n 0 < x < x_(n)0<x<x_{n}
ϕ ( x ) = ϕ ( 0 ) + ∫ 0 x − E ( x ) ⋅ d x = e N a x p 2 2 ε s − ∫ 0 x E max + e N d x ε s ⋅ d x = e N a x p 2 2 ε s + e N a x p x ε s − e N d x 2 2 ε s ϕ ( x ) = ϕ ( 0 ) + ∫ 0 x   − E ( x ) ⋅ d x = e N a x p 2 2 ε s − ∫ 0 x   E max + e N d x ε s ⋅ d x = e N a x p 2 2 ε s + e N a x p x ε s − e N d x 2 2 ε s {:[phi(x)=phi(0)+int_(0)^(x)-E(x)*dx],[=(eN_(a)x_(p)^(2))/(2epsi_(s))-int_(0)^(x)E_(max)+(eN_(d)x)/(epsi_(s))*dx],[=(eN_(a)x_(p)^(2))/(2epsi_(s))+(eN_(a)x_(p)x)/(epsi_(s))-(eN_(d)x^(2))/(2epsi_(s))]:}\begin{aligned} \phi(x) & =\phi(0)+\int_{0}^{x}-\mathrm{E}(x) \cdot d x \\ & =\frac{e N_{a} x_{p}^{2}}{2 \varepsilon_{s}}-\int_{0}^{x} \mathrm{E}_{\max }+\frac{e N_{d} x}{\varepsilon_{s}} \cdot d x \\ & =\frac{e N_{a} x_{p}^{2}}{2 \varepsilon_{s}}+\frac{e N_{a} x_{p} x}{\varepsilon_{s}}-\frac{e N_{d} x^{2}}{2 \varepsilon_{s}} \end{aligned}
Assuming a reference of ϕ ( − x p ) = 0 ϕ − x p = 0 phi(-x_(p))=0\phi\left(-x_{p}\right)=0
假设参考为 ϕ ( − x p ) = 0 ϕ − x p = 0 phi(-x_(p))=0\phi\left(-x_{p}\right)=0
Since the overall device is charge neutral,

3.1 One-sided Junctions  3.1 单边结点

A one-sided pn junction is a special case, where the analysis can be simplified. A one-sided pn junction is one where N a ≫ N d N a ≫ N d N_(a)≫N_(d)N_{a} \gg N_{d} (a p + + ^(+){ }^{+}n diode) or N d ≫ N a N d ≫ N a N_(d)≫N_(a)N_{d} \gg N_{a} (a n + + ^(+){ }^{+}p diode)
单边 pn 结是一种特殊情况，可以简化分析。单边 pn 结是指 N a ≫ N d N a ≫ N d N_(a)≫N_(d)N_{a} \gg N_{d} （p 型 + + ^(+){ }^{+} n 二极管）或 N d ≫ N a N d ≫ N a N_(d)≫N_(a)N_{d} \gg N_{a} （n 型 + + ^(+){ }^{+} p 二极管）
We saw earlier that
我们之前看到过
N a x p = N d x n N a x p = N d x n N_(a)x_(p)=N_(d)x_(n)N_{a} x_{p}=N_{d} x_{n}
so that for a p + n p + n p^(+)n\mathrm{p}^{+} \mathrm{n} diode where N a ≫ N d N a ≫ N d N_(a)≫N_(d)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{a}} \gg \mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{d}},
因此对于 p + n p + n p^(+)n\mathrm{p}^{+} \mathrm{n} 二极管，其中 N a ≫ N d N a ≫ N d N_(a)≫N_(d)\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{a}} \gg \mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{d}} ，
x p x n = N d N a → x p ≪ x n if N a ≫ N d x p x n = N d N a → x p ≪ x n  if  N a ≫ N d (x_(p))/(x_(n))=(N_(d))/(N_(a))quad rarrquadx_(p)≪x_(n)" if "quadN_(a)≫N_(d)\frac{x_{p}}{x_{n}}=\frac{N_{d}}{N_{a}} \quad \rightarrow \quad x_{p} \ll x_{n} \text { if } \quad N_{a} \gg N_{d}
i.e., most of the depletion width appears on the lowly doped side.
即大部分耗尽区宽度出现在掺杂较低的一侧。
From the perspective of the “equal & opposite area rule”, the higher the doping, the thinner the depletion layer.
从“等面积相反规则”的角度来看，掺杂浓度越高，耗尽层越薄。

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

If we apply a bias potential between the p & n regions, the system is no longer at thermal equilibrium & the Fermi level is not uniform throughout.
如果我们在 p 区和 n 区之间施加偏置电压，系统将不再处于热平衡状态，费米能级在整个区域内不再均匀。
V = applied voltage (generic)
V = 施加电压（通用）
V a = V a = V_(a)=\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{a}}= forward-bias voltage   V a = V a = V_(a)=\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{a}}= 正向偏压电压
V R = V R = V_(R)=\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{R}}= reverse-bias voltage   V R = V R = V_(R)=\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{R}}= 反向偏压电压
Bias condition:  偏置条件：
V > 0 : Forward bias, V = V a V < 0 : Reverse bias, V = − V R V > 0  : Forward bias,  V = V a V < 0  : Reverse bias,  V = − V R {:[V > 0" : Forward bias, "V=V_(a)],[V < 0" : Reverse bias, "V=-V_(R)]:}\begin{aligned} & V>0 \text { : Forward bias, } V=V_{a} \\ & V<0 \text { : Reverse bias, } V=-V_{R} \end{aligned}

While often neglected in a homojunction (a junction involving the same material - e.g. Si ), the vacuum level is an important energy level. To complete the picture, the vacuum level is parallel to E C E C E_(C)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}} and above it by an energy given by the electron affinity χ χ chi\chi.
虽然在同质结（涉及相同材料的结，例如硅）中常被忽略，真空能级是一个重要的能级。为了完整描述，真空能级与 E C E C E_(C)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}} 平行，并且高出它一个由电子亲和能 χ χ chi\chi 给出的能量。

Junction Potential Barrier
结势垒

  • We saw that the formation of a pn junction at thermal equilibrium results in a potential barrier.
    我们看到，在热平衡状态下形成的 PN 结会产生一个势垒。
  • Electrons in the CB on the n n nn-side will see an energy barrier of e V b i e V b i eV_(bi)e V_{b i} in crossing over to the p p pp side.
    位于 n n nn 一侧导带中的电子在穿越到 p p pp 侧时将遇到一个能量势垒 e V b i e V b i eV_(bi)e V_{b i} 。
  • Holes in the VB on the p-side will likewise see an energy barrier of eV bi eV bi eV_(bi)\mathrm{eV}_{\mathrm{bi}} in crossing over to the n-side.
    p 侧价带中的空穴在穿越到 n 侧时同样会遇到 eV bi eV bi eV_(bi)\mathrm{eV}_{\mathrm{bi}} 的能量势垒。

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

In reverse bias, the potential barrier increases, and the total potential barrier is
在反向偏置时，势垒增加，总势垒为
V total = V b i + V R V total  = V b i + V R V_("total ")=V_(bi)+V_(R)V_{\text {total }}=V_{b i}+V_{R}
The reverse-bias voltage appears as the difference between the Fermi levels on the p - and n- neutral regions.
反向偏置电压表现为 p 区和 n 区中性区费米能级之间的差异。
The applied voltage is dropped almost completely across the depletion region.
施加的电压几乎完全降落在耗尽区。
At thermal equilibrium (zero bias)
热平衡时（零偏置）

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

Under forward bias, the potential barrier decreases, and the total potential barrier is
在正向偏置下，势垒电压减小，总势垒电压为
V total = V b i − V a V total  = V b i − V a V_("total ")=V_(bi)-V_(a)V_{\text {total }}=V_{b i}-V_{a}
Note: Under forward bias, a substantial current flows, and may cause significant voltage drops in the neutral regions (simply due to V = IR V = IR V=IR\mathrm{V}=\mathrm{IR}, where R is the resistance of the neutral regions)
注意：在正向偏置下，会有大量电流流过，可能导致中性区出现显著的电压降（仅仅由于 V = IR V = IR V=IR\mathrm{V}=\mathrm{IR} ，其中 R 是中性区的电阻）

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

  1. Effect of bias on space charge region
    偏压对空间电荷区的影响
Consider what happens when you bias a pair of capacitor plates.
考虑当你给一对电容器板加偏压时会发生什么。
An applied bias results in charges, which appear on the surface of the plates (if they are metal).
施加的偏压会导致电荷出现在板的表面（如果它们是金属的话）。
These charges give rise to an electric field, according to Gauss’s Law.
根据高斯定律，这些电荷会产生电场。



No bias  无偏压

With external bias  施加外部偏压时

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

In the case of a pn junction, there are already charges in the SCR under zero bias. An applied bias results in additional electric field across the junction.
在 PN 结的情况下，零偏压时耗尽区内已经存在电荷。施加偏压会在结区产生额外的电场。
Under reverse bias, the additional electric field is in the same direction as, and reinforces the built-in field.
在反向偏压下，额外的电场方向与内建电场相同，并增强内建电场。
By Gauss’s Law, the space charge is increased.
根据高斯定律，空间电荷增加。
Since the acceptor / donor concentration is fixed for the junction, the additional space charge can only come about by increasing the width of the SCR.
由于结区的受主/施主浓度是固定的，额外的空间电荷只能通过增加空间电荷区的宽度来实现。

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

Under forward bias, the additional electric field is in the opposite direction to the built-in field, and reduces the built-in field.
在正向偏置下，额外的电场方向与内建电场相反，减弱了内建电场。
As such the, the space charge is decreased, and the width of the space charge region decreases.
因此，空间电荷减少，空间电荷区的宽度减小。

No bias  无偏置
Forward bias  正向偏置

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结


With a change in the space-charge region width, the electric field and potential also change accordingly.
随着空间电荷区宽度的变化，电场和电势也相应变化。
Under reverse bias ( V = − V R V = − V R V=-V_(R)V=-V_{R} ), the peak electric field increases (in magnitude), and the potential barrier increases to V total = V bi + V R V total  = V bi  + V R V_("total ")=V_("bi ")+V_(R)V_{\text {total }}=V_{\text {bi }}+V_{R}
在反向偏置（ V = − V R V = − V R V=-V_(R)V=-V_{R} ）下，峰值电场（大小）增加，势垒电势增加到 V total = V bi + V R V total  = V bi  + V R V_("total ")=V_("bi ")+V_(R)V_{\text {total }}=V_{\text {bi }}+V_{R}
Under forward bias ( V = V a V = V a V=V_(a)V=V_{\mathrm{a}} ), the peak electric field decreases (in magnitude), and the potential barrier decreases to V total = V bi − V a V total  = V bi  − V a V_("total ")=V_("bi ")-V_(a)V_{\text {total }}=V_{\text {bi }}-V_{a}
在正向偏置（ V = V a V = V a V=V_(a)V=V_{\mathrm{a}} ）下，峰值电场（大小）减小，势垒电势降低到 V total = V bi − V a V total  = V bi  − V a V_("total ")=V_("bi ")-V_(a)V_{\text {total }}=V_{\text {bi }}-V_{a}

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

In the previous derivation of the total SCR width at zero bias (thermal equilibrium),
在之前关于零偏（热平衡）下总耗尽区宽度的推导中，
W = { 2 ε s V b i e [ N a + N d N a ⋅ N d ] } 1 / 2 W = 2 ε s V b i e N a + N d N a ⋅ N d 1 / 2 W={(2epsi_(s)V_(bi))/(e)[(N_(a)+N_(d))/(N_(a)*N_(d))]}^(1//2)W=\left\{\frac{2 \varepsilon_{s} V_{b i}}{e}\left[\frac{N_{a}+N_{d}}{N_{a} \cdot N_{d}}\right]\right\}^{1 / 2}
the potential difference across the SCR was V bi V bi  V_("bi ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {bi }}.
耗尽区两端的电势差为 V bi V bi  V_("bi ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {bi }} 。
We can thus replace V bi V bi  V_("bi ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {bi }} by V total V total  V_("total ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {total }} to obtain the SCR width under bias,
因此我们可以用 V total V total  V_("total ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {total }} 替代 V bi V bi  V_("bi ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {bi }} ，以得到加偏压下的耗尽区宽度，
W ( V ) = { 2 ε s V total e [ N a + N d N a ⋅ N d ] } 1 / 2 W ( V ) = 2 ε s V total  e N a + N d N a ⋅ N d 1 / 2 W(V)={(2epsi_(s)V_("total "))/(e)[(N_(a)+N_(d))/(N_(a)*N_(d))]}^(1//2)W(V)=\left\{\frac{2 \varepsilon_{s} V_{\text {total }}}{e}\left[\frac{N_{a}+N_{d}}{N_{a} \cdot N_{d}}\right]\right\}^{1 / 2}
Hence,  因此，
W = { 2 ε s ( V b i + V R ) e [ N a + N d N a ⋅ N d ] } 1 / 2 : Reverse bias, V = − V R W = { 2 ε s ( V b i − V a ) e [ N a + N d N a ⋅ N d ] } 1 / 2 : Forward bias, V = V a W = 2 ε s V b i + V R e N a + N d N a ⋅ N d 1 / 2 :  Reverse bias,  V = − V R W = 2 ε s V b i − V a e N a + N d N a ⋅ N d 1 / 2 :  Forward bias,  V = V a {:[W={(2epsi_(s)(V_(bi)+V_(R)))/(e)[(N_(a)+N_(d))/(N_(a)*N_(d))]}^(1//2),:" Reverse bias, "V=-V_(R)],[W={(2epsi_(s)(V_(bi)-V_(a)))/(e)[(N_(a)+N_(d))/(N_(a)*N_(d))]}^(1//2),:" Forward bias, "V=V_(a)]:}\begin{array}{ll} W=\left\{\frac{2 \varepsilon_{s}\left(V_{b i}+V_{R}\right)}{e}\left[\frac{N_{a}+N_{d}}{N_{a} \cdot N_{d}}\right]\right\}^{1 / 2} & : \text { Reverse bias, } V=-V_{R} \\ W=\left\{\frac{2 \varepsilon_{s}\left(V_{b i}-V_{a}\right)}{e}\left[\frac{N_{a}+N_{d}}{N_{a} \cdot N_{d}}\right]\right\}^{1 / 2} & : \text { Forward bias, } V=V_{a} \end{array}

4.3 Carrier flow under bias
4.3 偏压下的载流子流动

Zero Bias  零偏压
Reverse Bias  反向偏压
Forward Bias  正向偏压
Energy Bands and Potential Distribution of a PN Junction under Bias
施加偏压下 PN 结的能带和电势分布

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

Recall that at thermal equilibrium (zero bias) the barrier is established such that the flux of carriers from the p -side to the n -side balances each other, resulting in zero net flux.
回顾在热平衡（零偏压）时，势垒建立使得从 p 区到 n 区的载流子通量相互平衡，导致净通量为零。
Under reverse bias, the barrier increases, so while the electron flux from p p pp-side to n n nn-side is the same as before, the electron flux from n n nn to p p pp is now much smaller - in fact practically zero beyond a small V R V R V_(R)V_{R}. This gives rise to a net electron flux from p to n .
在反向偏置下，势垒增加，因此虽然从 p p pp 侧到 n n nn 侧的电子流量与之前相同，但从 n n nn 到 p p pp 的电子流量现在要小得多——实际上除了一个很小的 V R V R V_(R)V_{R} 之外几乎为零。这导致了从 p 侧到 n 侧的净电子流。
Similar for the hole flux.
空穴流量也是类似的。

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结

This net electron flux from the pside to the n-side, and net hole flux from the n -side to the p -side, give rise to the reverse saturation current density, J s J s J_(s)\mathrm{J}_{\mathrm{s}}.
这种从 p 侧到 n 侧的净电子流和从 n 侧到 p 侧的净空穴流产生了反向饱和电流密度 J s J s J_(s)\mathrm{J}_{\mathrm{s}} 。
The reverse saturation current density is very small, because the carrier fluxes originate from the sides where the carriers are minority carriers.
反向饱和电流密度非常小，因为载流子通量来自载流子为少数载流子的一侧。
I = J × = J × =Jxx=\mathrm{J} \times (Area)  我 = J × = J × =Jxx=\mathrm{J} \times （面积）

PN Junction with Applied Voltage
施加电压的 PN 结


p-side  p 侧
n-side  n 侧
Under forward bias, the barrier decreases.
在正向偏置下，势垒减小。
The electron flux from the p -side to the n -side remains the same, but with a lowered barrier, there is a large electron flux from the n - to the p -side. This results in a net electron flux from the n-side to the pside. Similar for holes.
从 p 侧到 n 侧的电子通量保持不变，但由于势垒降低，从 n 侧到 p 侧的电子通量大大增加。这导致电子净通量从 n 侧流向 p 侧。空穴情况类似。
Unlike the reverse bias case, where the carrier flux saturates once V R V R V_(R)\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{R}} gets large, under forward bias, an increase in V a V a V_(a)V_{a} reduces the barrier further and increases the carrier flux.
与反向偏置情况下载流子通量在 V R V R V_(R)\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{R}} 变大后饱和不同，在正向偏置下， V a V a V_(a)V_{a} 的增加进一步降低势垒并增加载流子通量。
The increase in I with V a V a V_(a)V_{a} is ∼ ∼ ∼\sim exponential.
电流 I 随 V a V a V_(a)V_{a} 的增加呈 ∼ ∼ ∼\sim 指数增长。
